title.rendered: EWC Graduate Degree Fellowship in the United States | Fully Funded

content.rendered:
East West Centre Graduate Degree Fellowship in the United States welcomes committed, hardworking, and passionate young graduates from around the globe.

EWC Fellowship Application Deadline:

  • The application deadline is December 01, 2026.

Program Level:

  • Master’s Level.
  • Doctoral Level.

Benefits:

  • Health insurance.
  • Books expense.
  • Housing in an EWC dormitory.
  • Partial funding towards meals.
